name: AI UI Style Vault Interactive Effect Intelligence
principle: Select by business purpose; none is a first-class valid result.
runtimeRules: Prefer the lowest-complexity runtime that can express the approved interaction.
Do not merge revision-specific Three.js renderers blindly; isolate incompatible runtimes.
Every animated effect needs a reduced-motion fallback.
High-cost effects that miss mobile budgets must simplify or fall back.
semanticRules: Every effect must support a verified product, service, asset, place, workflow or conversion goal.
Data-looking visuals must not be presented as live telemetry without a real dataset.
Procedural scenery must not be presented as a literal depiction of a real property, venue or destination.
Approved media remains primary for real people, products, properties, venues and events.
Route to the 3D interaction-intent system when the subject becomes explorable, configurable or spatially informative.

effects.label: Ambient Particle Network
effects.summary: Restrained connected points/lines for a genuine technology or connectivity narrative.
avoid: professional services with no technology narrative

effects.label: Data Topology Field
effects.summary: Abstract topology/flow metaphor for real data, infrastructure, automation or integration concepts.
effects.mobile: Lower render resolution and simplify geometry.

effects.label: Fluid Organic Field
effects.summary: Slow organic motion for evidenced wellness, beauty, botanical or sensory positioning.
effects.mobile: Reduce simulation resolution and disable pointer response.
effects.reducedMotion: Soft static gradient or approved image.

effects.label: Kinetic Editorial Type
effects.summary: Motion applied to concise real headings while preserving readable static text.
effects.mobile: Reduce transforms and keep line breaks stable.

effects.label: Tactile Premium CTA
effects.summary: Premium button feedback for a real primary conversion without obscuring button semantics.
effects.mobile: Retain press/focus feedback; remove decorative motion.
avoid: secondary actions where hierarchy would become noisy

effects.label: Liquid Metal CTA
effects.summary: High-character CTA for a deliberately expressive campaign or product moment.
effects.mobile: Replace with tactile CSS button on constrained devices.

effects.label: Cinematic Media Reveal
effects.summary: Responsive media reveal for approved asset-led fashion, hospitality, property, event or beauty stories.
effects.mobile: Use opacity/transform only and avoid pinned sequences.
effects.reducedMotion: Static media grid with identical approved assets.

effects.label: Animated Dock Navigation
effects.summary: Compact animated wayfinding for a small, stable destination set.
effects.mobile: Disable magnification and retain clear labels.

effects.label: Orbital Product Accent
effects.summary: Restrained orbital metaphor for a product core, platform ecosystem or central capability.
effects.mobile: Reduce geometry and freeze camera on coarse pointers.
avoid: pages already using a primary 3D subject

effects.label: Generative Landscape Accent
effects.summary: Decorative procedural environment accent for place-led storytelling; never literal property imagery.
effects.mobile: Simplify layers and motion; use static fallback on low capability.
effects.reducedMotion: Static decorative illustration clearly marked as concept/decorative.
avoid: property detail pages requiring accurate photography
any context where concept art could be mistaken for reality
